idempotency._meaning: An operation that produces the same result no matter how many times it is applied, making retries safe.

eventual consistency._meaning: Replicas may diverge temporarily but converge to the same state given no new updates.

strong consistency._meaning: Every read returns the most recent committed write, at the cost of availability/latency.

causal consistency._meaning: Operations causally related are seen in the same order by all nodes; unrelated ones may differ.

consensus algorithm._meaning: A protocol by which distributed nodes agree on a single value/ordering despite failures.

quorum._meaning: The minimum number of nodes that must agree for a read/write to be considered valid.

CAP theorem._meaning: A distributed store can guarantee only two of consistency, availability, and partition tolerance.

split brain._meaning: A partition leaves cluster nodes operating independently, risking conflicting state.

stale read._meaning: A read that returns outdated data because the replica has not yet caught up.

circuit breaker._meaning: A pattern that stops calls to a failing dependency until it recovers, preventing cascade failures.

bulkhead._meaning: Isolates resources into pools so one component's failure cannot exhaust the whole system.

exponential backoff._meaning: A retry strategy where wait time grows exponentially to avoid flooding a recovering service.

graceful degradation._meaning: Keeping core functionality available with reduced capability when parts of a system fail.

backpressure._meaning: A mechanism where a slow consumer signals upstream producers to slow down.

cascading failure._meaning: A failure in one component triggers a chain reaction across dependent components.

fail fast._meaning: Reporting failure immediately rather than continuing in an invalid state.

thundering herd._meaning: Many waiting processes wake at once and contend for the same resource, causing a load spike.

optimistic locking._meaning: Assume no conflict, validate on commit, and retry if a concurrent change is detected.

pessimistic locking._meaning: Lock data up front to prevent concurrent modification.

write-ahead log._meaning: Changes are written to a sequential log before data pages, enabling crash recovery.

isolation level._meaning: Defines which concurrency anomalies a transaction may observe.

phantom read._meaning: A re-run range query returns new rows inserted by another committed transaction.

dirty read._meaning: Reading data written by another transaction that has not yet committed.

N+1 query._meaning: An ORM issues one query per row in a loop instead of a single batched query.

ACID._meaning: The four guarantees that make database transactions reliable.

sharding._meaning: Splitting a dataset horizontally across nodes by a shard key to scale writes.

serializable._meaning: The strictest isolation, equivalent to transactions running one at a time.

cache stampede._meaning: Expiry of a hot key triggers many concurrent regenerations that overwhelm the backend.

cache invalidation._meaning: Removing or refreshing cache entries when the underlying data changes.

cache-aside._meaning: App reads cache first and loads from DB on a miss, then populates the cache.

write-through cache._meaning: Writes go to cache and backing store synchronously to keep them consistent.

tail latency._meaning: The high-percentile (p99/p999) response time that dominates user-visible slowness.

p99 latency._meaning: The latency below which 99% of requests complete; surfaces worst-case behavior averages hide.

head-of-line blocking._meaning: A slow item at the front of a queue blocks all items behind it.

hot spot._meaning: A node or key receiving disproportionate load, limiting scalability.

SQL injection._meaning: Injecting malicious SQL through unsanitized input to manipulate a database query.

XSS._meaning: Injecting malicious scripts into pages viewed by other users.

CSRF._meaning: Tricking a logged-in user's browser into sending an unwanted authenticated request.

SSRF._meaning: Coercing a server into making requests to unintended internal resources.

same-origin policy._meaning: A browser rule restricting how a document from one origin interacts with another.

input sanitization._meaning: Cleaning untrusted input to prevent injection attacks.

principle of least privilege._meaning: Granting only the minimum permissions needed to perform a task.

egress filtering._meaning: Controlling outbound traffic to prevent exfiltration or SSRF abuse.

at-least-once delivery._meaning: A message is guaranteed delivered but may arrive more than once, requiring idempotent handling.

exactly-once delivery._meaning: Each message is processed exactly one time, typically via dedup or transactions.

dead letter queue._meaning: A queue that captures messages that cannot be processed after retries.

saga pattern._meaning: Coordinating a distributed transaction as a sequence of local steps with compensations.

event sourcing._meaning: Storing state changes as an immutable sequence of events to derive current state.

poison message._meaning: A message that repeatedly fails processing and crashes the consumer.

choreography._meaning: Services coordinate by reacting to each other's events without a central controller.

orchestration._meaning: A central coordinator explicitly drives a distributed workflow's steps.

服务网格._meaning: 把服务间通信治理下沉到独立基础设施层（sidecar 代理）的架构模式

熔断器模式._meaning: 下游故障时快速失败、保护上游、自动恢复的容错设计模式（Hystrix/Sentinel）

削峰填谷._meaning: 用消息队列把瞬时高峰流量缓冲成平滑流量的后端设计手段

死信队列._meaning: 存放无法被正常消费消息的特殊队列，用于异常隔离与重试

幂等消费._meaning: 同一消息被重复投递时保证业务结果不变的消费保障机制

接口幂等性._meaning: 同一请求被多次调用产生相同副作用的接口设计原则

两阶段提交._meaning: 分布式事务靠协调者分准备/提交两阶段达成一致的协议

TCC事务._meaning: Try-Confirm-Cancel 三段式补偿型柔性分布式事务方案

SAGA模式._meaning: 长流程多参与方下用补偿操作回滚的最终一致性事务模式

本地消息表._meaning: 把消息写本地库与业务同事务、再异步投递保证可靠的方案

雪崩效应._meaning: 一个服务故障引起调用链连锁失败拖垮整体的分布式现象

服务隔离._meaning: 用线程池/信号量把不同依赖隔开防止互相拖垮的容错手段

race condition._meaning: A bug where program behavior depends on the unpredictable timing of concurrent accesses.

deadlock._meaning: Two or more threads block forever, each waiting for a resource the other holds.

thread safety._meaning: Code that behaves correctly when accessed by multiple threads simultaneously.

mutual exclusion._meaning: Ensuring only one thread enters a critical section at a time.

livelock._meaning: Threads keep changing state in response to each other but make no actual progress.

lock contention._meaning: Performance loss when many threads compete for the same lock.

memory leak._meaning: Memory that is allocated but never freed, causing usage to grow over time.

reference cycle._meaning: Objects referencing each other keep a refcount above zero and leak.

TTL._meaning: A duration after which a cached entry is considered expired.

distributed tracing._meaning: Following a request's path across service boundaries to find where latency/errors arise.

structured logging._meaning: Emitting logs as machine-parseable fields rather than free text for filtering/aggregation.

cardinality explosion._meaning: Too many unique label combinations cause metric storage/query cost to blow up.

error budget._meaning: The allowed amount of unreliability before action is required, derived from an SLO.

golden signals._meaning: The four key signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation) to monitor a service.

telemetry._meaning: The data (logs, metrics, traces) emitted by systems for observability.

saturation._meaning: How full a resource is relative to its capacity; a leading overload indicator.

LRU eviction._meaning: An eviction policy that discards the entry not accessed for the longest time.

Amdahl's law._meaning: Maximum speedup from parallelism is bounded by the serial fraction of the work.

memoization._meaning: Caching the result of an expensive pure function call keyed by its arguments.

mark and sweep._meaning: A GC algorithm marking reachable objects then sweeping the unmarked ones.

回溯算法._meaning: 深度优先逐步试探、不满足约束就撤销回退的解空间搜索范式

分治法._meaning: 把大问题拆成独立同构子问题各个击破再合并的算法范式

贪心算法._meaning: 每步取当前最优、期望逼近全局最优的算法策略

分支限界._meaning: 用界限函数剪掉不可能产生最优解分支的搜索法

记忆化搜索._meaning: 递归中缓存子问题结果避免重复计算的优化（自顶向下DP）

最优子结构._meaning: 问题最优解包含子问题最优解、是用DP的前提性质

重叠子问题._meaning: 递归过程中相同子问题被反复求解、DP 区别分治的特征

状态转移方程._meaning: 描述当前状态由哪些前序状态推导而来的 DP 核心递推式

剪枝优化._meaning: 搜索中提前排除无效分支以降复杂度的技巧

深度优先搜索._meaning: 沿一条路走到底再回退的图/树遍历策略

dependency injection._meaning: Supplying a class's dependencies externally instead of constructing them internally.

inversion of control._meaning: The framework, not your code, controls program flow and calls into your code.

observer pattern._meaning: A one-to-many dependency where subjects notify observers of state changes.

strategy pattern._meaning: Encapsulating interchangeable algorithms selectable at runtime.

singleton pattern._meaning: Ensuring a class has only one instance with a global access point.

factory pattern._meaning: Delegating object creation to a method/class instead of direct constructors.

template method._meaning: Defining an algorithm skeleton in a base class, letting subclasses override steps.

publish-subscribe._meaning: Senders publish to topics and receivers subscribe without knowing each other.

code smell._meaning: A surface symptom in code that hints at a deeper design problem.

technical debt._meaning: The future cost incurred by choosing an expedient solution over a better one.

refactoring._meaning: Restructuring code internally without changing its external behavior.

coupling._meaning: The degree of interdependence between software modules.

cohesion._meaning: How well the elements within a module belong together.

leaky abstraction._meaning: An abstraction that exposes underlying implementation details it should hide.

premature optimization._meaning: Optimizing before measuring, adding complexity for unproven gains.

DRY._meaning: Every piece of knowledge should have a single authoritative representation.

feature envy._meaning: A method that uses another class's data more than its own, signaling misplacement.

god object._meaning: A class that knows or does too much, violating single responsibility.

separation of concerns._meaning: Splitting a program into distinct sections each addressing one concern.

garbage collection._meaning: Automatic reclamation of memory no longer referenced by the program.

stop-the-world._meaning: A GC phase that suspends application execution until collection completes.

reference counting._meaning: Tracking the number of references to an object and freeing it at zero.

heap fragmentation._meaning: Free memory split into small non-contiguous blocks, wasting capacity.

聚簇索引._meaning: 叶子节点直接存整行数据、按主键物理排序的索引组织方式

覆盖索引._meaning: 查询字段全在索引中、无需回表读主键的优化手段

回表查询._meaning: 普通索引拿到主键后再回聚簇索引读整行的额外开销

最左前缀._meaning: 联合索引按从左到右连续匹配才能命中的匹配规则

B加树._meaning: 叶子相连、适合范围扫描的多叉平衡树，关系库索引基础结构

LSM树._meaning: 先写内存再批量刷盘合并、写性能优于读的存储结构

预写日志._meaning: 修改先落日志再改数据文件、保证崩溃可恢复的机制

读已提交._meaning: 只能读到已提交数据、可避免脏读的事务隔离级别

可重复读._meaning: 事务内多次读一致、靠快照解决不可重复读的隔离级别

不可重复读._meaning: 同一事务两次读同一行结果不同的并发异常现象

临键锁._meaning: 记录锁加间隙锁的组合、当前读防幻读的锁机制

快照读._meaning: 普通 select 读 MVCC 历史版本而不加锁的读方式

回滚日志._meaning: 记录修改前镜像、支撑事务回滚与 MVCC 版本链的日志

concepts: 专门给查询用的数据视图
读视图._meaning: MVCC 中决定某版本对当前事务是否可见的快照

布隆过滤器._meaning: 用位图加多哈希判断元素"可能存在/一定不存在"的概率结构

一致性哈希._meaning: 增删节点只迁移少量数据的哈希分片算法（含虚拟节点/圆环）

热点key._meaning: 高并发集中访问的单 key，失效瞬间易压垮数据库

多级缓存._meaning: 本地缓存加分布式缓存层叠、缓解雪崩的缓存架构

CAS操作._meaning: 比较并交换的原子指令，乐观锁与无锁结构的基础

ABA问题._meaning: 值从A改成B又改回A、CAS 误判未变的并发隐患

自旋锁._meaning: 拿不到锁时循环忙等而不阻塞线程的轻量锁

悲观锁._meaning: 假设必有并发冲突、操作前先加锁独占的策略

读写锁._meaning: 读读共享、读写/写写互斥的并发锁，提升读多写少性能

内存屏障._meaning: 禁止指令重排、保证内存可见性顺序的底层并发原语

协程._meaning: 用户态可挂起恢复的轻量级线程，高并发低开销

锁升级._meaning: synchronized 从偏向到轻量到重量逐级膨胀的优化过程

锁消除._meaning: JIT 判断无竞争时去掉不必要同步的优化

锁粗化._meaning: 把相邻多次加锁合并成一次以减少开销的优化

原子操作._meaning: 不可被线程切割打断、要么全做要么全不做的操作

混合开发._meaning: 原生壳套 WebView 加 H5 页面的移动端开发模式

跨平台框架._meaning: 一套代码多端运行（Flutter/RN/uniapp）的移动方案

原生渲染._meaning: 用平台原生控件/自绘引擎渲染保证性能的方式

包体积优化._meaning: 通过代码混淆/资源压缩/ABI过滤减小安装包的优化

动态加载._meaning: 把非首屏模块拆出按需下载加载减小首包的手段

冷启动优化._meaning: 缩短 App 从点击到首屏可交互耗时的优化方向

桥接通信._meaning: JS 层与原生层通过桥互相调用的跨平台通信机制

容器编排._meaning: 自动部署/扩缩/调度大量容器的运维能力（Kubernetes）

服务发现._meaning: 实时获取后端实例变化并动态更新路由的机制

声明式配置._meaning: 只声明期望状态、由控制器自动收敛达成的管理范式

持续集成._meaning: 频繁把代码并入主干并自动构建测试的实践

持续交付._meaning: 改动自动测试并打包到制品库随时可部署的实践

流水线._meaning: 串联提交/构建/测试/部署各阶段的自动化链路

制品库._meaning: 存放构建产物的不可变发布包仓库

不可变基础设施._meaning: 实例从不原地改而是整体替换重建的运维范式

渐进式发布._meaning: 渐进释放流量并实时监控风险的发布方式（GitOps）
